message.content: {"caption":"A four-series line chart of in-distribution accuracy over training steps is paired with a benchmark table comparing base models, SimpleRL, and AZR.","description":"The figure has two panels, labeled (a) and (b). Panel (a) is a line chart with Training Steps on the horizontal axis (50–250) and In-Distribution Accuracy on the vertical axis (0.30–0.70 tick labels; the teal line rises slightly above 0.70). The legend identifies four series: blue AZR-Llama3.1-8b, orange AZR-3B-Coder, red AZR-7B-Coder, and teal AZR-14B-Coder. The plotted trends are estimated: blue rises from about 0.37 to 0.43 by step 100, dips to about 0.41 at 150, and is about 0.42 at 200; orange rises from about 0.37 to 0.46 by 150, then eases to about 0.44 at 250; red rises from about 0.53 to 0.58 by 100, stays near 0.58 through 200, and reaches 0.60 at 250; teal starts near 0.65, is nearly flat through 100, then climbs to about 0.68 at 150, 0.69 at 200, and 0.72 at 250. Panel (b) is a table with columns Model Family, Variant, Code Avg, Math Avg, and Total Avg. The base Llama3.1-8b row has 28.5, 3.4, and 16.0; its + SimpleRL [85] row has 33.7 (+5.2), 7.2 (+3.8), and 20.5 (+4.5); its + AZR (Ours) row has 31.6 (+3.1), 6.8 (+3.4), and 19.2 (+3.2). The base Qwen2.5-3B Coder row has 51.2, 18.8, and 35.0; its + AZR (Ours) row has 54.9 (+3.7), 26.5 (+7.7), and 40.7 (+5.7). The base Qwen2.5-7B Coder row has 56.6, 23.9, and 40.2; its + AZR (Ours) row has 61.6 (+5.0), 39.1 (+15.2), and 50.4 (+10.2). The base Qwen2.5-14B Coder row has 60.0, 20.2, and 40.1; its + AZR (Ours) row has 63.6 (+3.6), 43.0 (+22.8), and 53.3 (+13.2). Parenthetical gains are printed in green beside the AZR or SimpleRL scores. The AZR rows are shaded pale blue, and the SimpleRL row is shaded pale gray.
